_comment: Seed data for customer breakdown dropdowns. Sourced from 15 historical job breakdown Excel files (R1081-R1394, March 2019). New entries added via the portal will be appended to this file OR the Google Sheets BreakdownDropdowns tab — whichever source is configured in customer-breakdown-service.ts. Amounts above the thresholds in new-entry-thresholds trigger a notification to Sara, Chris, and Michael.

workersComp.description: Auto-added to labor total if no Workers Comp line item present. Rate applied to Labor subtotal.

profitSplits._comment: Sales Rep = 50% of profit. Pres/VP = 15% each. Remaining 20% stays with company. Pres/VP are admin-tier only (hidden from managers/sales/PMs).

newEntryThresholds._comment: If a NEW supplier (not in dropdown) is used for more than $2500 on a single breakdown, email Sara/Chris/Michael. Same for NEW subcontractor over $1000. Protects against unauthorized vendor relationships.

permissions._comment: canCreate roles can submit breakdowns (Michael, Chris, Sara, Destin, Tia). canViewAdminTier sees the Pres/VP lines (Michael, Chris, Sara only). Sales reps and PMs see only their own job with Sales Rep commission hidden below.

inspectorInitials._comment: Legacy initials from 2019 sheets — inspectors should now be selected from current team roster via getTeamMembersByRole
